system.description: Spend six Blood Traits to sink into the ground and disperse your form across a three-mile radius to a depth of six feet, similar to Earth Meld. You require no blood for sustenance while dispersed, may use mental Disciplines and initiate Telepathy on anyone within your area (contact is assumed for anyone on bare earth above you), and are nearly invulnerable except to nuclear-scale subterranean explosions, which inflict one to three levels of aggravated damage that cannot be healed until you emerge.
